## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes (if any). Include
relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would change existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation / examples update
- [ ] Release / chore

## How Has This Been Tested?

Please describe the tests you ran to verify your change:

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm test:fixtures`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] Manual smoke test

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code where it is non-obvious
- [ ] I have updated the relevant documentation (`docs/`, README)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective / feature works
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are included (check for `.env`, API keys)
- [ ] Commit message follows the repository convention
